source.identity_marker: SOURCE_COMMIT in the pinned source snapshot; the checkout has no .git metadata
source.checkpoint_training: completed sparse formal run, 2 epochs; no retraining in this experiment

comparison.cold_start: official behavior: encode only the latest real observation at each replan; pass the same five future action blocks
comparison.real_history: use real observations at t-10,t-5,t and the two matching executed action blocks, followed by the identical five future action blocks
comparison.first_replan: both arms are cold starts because no real history exists yet

mechanism_gate.contexts: first 8 of the prior formal 29 final-failure task indices, sorted ascending; fixed diagnostic cohort, selected before any new mechanism metric
mechanism_gate.anchors: zero-based replans 1 and 2, only for still-active tasks; preserve original task identity and eval_seed=99*original_index+1
mechanism_gate.candidate_source: new diagnostic native cold-start CEM capture on frozen task states/goals/checkpoint; capture early and late populations plus late elites without changing CEM RNG calls
mechanism_gate.candidate_bank_size: 300 per context; cost-only calibration estimates resources and cannot shrink the bank; if beyond cap, stop and request a resource decision
mechanism_gate.candidate_bank_composition: 100 fixed-index early proposals from CEM iteration 0 + 170 fixed-index late non-elites + all 30 final late elites; preserve and record repeated sequences/provenance
mechanism_gate.primary_reference: physics-replayed candidate endpoints; score=(norm(goal_state[:4]-endpoint_state[:4])/20)^2+(wrapped_angle_error/(pi/9))^2, a diagnostic cost rather than the official success predicate; also report object-only 2D position error separately
mechanism_gate.primary_summary: compare each arm's true mean task score among its predictor-selected top 30 bank candidates, plus elite regret versus the 30 lowest true scores; average matched anchors within task before task-level gate
mechanism_gate.proposed_support_gate: history3 proceeds only if median task-level relative elite-regret reduction is at least 10% and at least ceil(5/8*n_nonfloor) tasks improve; denominator floor is 0.01 score units; tasks with cold-start regret below the floor are reported at-floor and excluded from the percentage gate; root approved definitions before mechanism metrics exist
mechanism_gate.minimum_valid_sample: at least 12 paired task-contexts across at least 6 tasks and at least 6 non-at-floor tasks; otherwise incomplete, not NO_GO; tasks with only one paired anchor remain eligible and missing anchors are not imputed
secondary_diagnostics: paired fixed-horizon linked-latent rollout MSE against the same encoder applied to real future observations
per-context candidate ranking against replayed task outcomes

using bank index 0 as fixed reference, candidate-relative terminal linked-latent delta direction cosine and magnitude ratio against real-future encoder delta; no added perturbation bank; true delta norm <=1e-8 is degenerate and omitted from cosine
mechanism_gate.aggregation_unit: task, then replanning context; candidates are not independent samples
mechanism_gate.negative_gate: valid failure to meet the frozen support gate is NO_GO and stops before closed-loop evaluation
mechanism_gate.data_blocker: the original plan_targets.pkl stores targets and gt_actions, not native MPC action sequences or CEM banks; native CEM proposals and executed context actions must be captured in a new diagnostic run. Do not describe it as replay of earlier native trajectories/outcomes.
